description: Enhanced size-limited buffer edge cases: writing content whose length exactly equals the maximum is preserved (the limit is inclusive), content one byte over the maximum yields the size-exceeded error, empty content is preserved as the empty string, unlimited mode (max of zero) with a tiny memory window preserves long content by spilling to disk, and reading content that exactly fills a spilled buffer replays it exactly. Each case reports the preserved content or the normalized size-exceeded error.
